http/cache_admission#

One request at a time per cache key: concurrent misses for one URL wait for the first to fill the cache.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

One request at a time per cache key: concurrent misses for one URL wait for the first to fill the cache. Caching uses it; programs do not.
